# eWork Social

> eWork Social is an all-in-one social media management platform for agencies, freelancers and brands. Schedule posts across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and more; manage clients and a CRM; send posts to clients for approval; reply to messages and comments in one inbox; and use AI to write captions and plan content.

Built for digital agencies and social media managers, including in Africa, and designed for use worldwide. A 7-day free trial is available.
